## Rule

Decoded 2026-06-07 from ARC-GEN `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_f8a8fe49.py`.
Input has a red (2) gripper/box and gray (5) pixels inside it. Output leaves the
red gripper fixed and reflects each gray pixel outside across the nearest red bar.
The generator may transpose the entire grid, so the same rule applies horizontally
or vertically. ARC-GEN bounds the active grid at 15x15; official train/test include
the same shape and some hand-positioned `brow=4` examples, so do not hardcode only
the random `brow=3` stream.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
red = input == 2
gray = input == 5
r0, r1 = first_last_rows_with_red(red)
c0, c1 = first_last_cols_with_red(red)
horizontal = (r1 - r0) > (c1 - c0)
lo, hi = (r0, r1) if horizontal else (c0, c1)

for each output axis index j:
    top_src = 2 * lo - j
    bot_src = 2 * hi - j
    source_idx[j] = top_src if j < lo and 2 * top_src < lo + hi else 0
    source_idx[j] = bot_src if j > hi and 2 * bot_src > lo + hi else source_idx[j]

gray_out = gather(gray, source_idx, axis=rows if horizontal else cols)
output_color = 2 * red + 5 * gray_out
output = one_hot(output_color, sentinel outside 15x15)
```

## Cost analysis

**2026-07-12 (bo_ng_cld_worker2, Claude lane) — LIVE bar is now Sho's ENUMERATION
formulation (2514), a different graph than this lane's Gather rungs below.**
The live team-best `Team_Best_Onnx/task390.onnx` (sha `890ed508…e064f2`, 2514,
owner Sho) is NOT the Gather/table-indexselect graph this doc's older floor
analysis covers — it is a per-position enumeration: (1) a 1×1 Conv `w_code`
maps the one-hot input to a scalar color code (2=red, 1=everything-else) over a
10×10 crop `red_core_code_f` F32 400B; (2) 10 F32 slices extract the input gray
channel at rows 5-9 / cols 5-9; (3) orientation flags h3/h4/h10/h11/v10/v11
route gray to the reflected border rows/cols via And/Or/Where; (4) a 15×15 code
plane `color4d`∈{1,2,3} is assembled; (5) `feat2=[color4d, color4d²]` →
QLinearConv Lagrange-decodes to one-hot channels {0,2,5} AND pads 15→30 in one
free-output op. Codes {1,2,3} (not {0,..}) are REQUIRED so the conv-pad region
(feat=0) decodes to all-zero/sentinel (trimmed), not to background ch0.

Shave staged: the 10 gray masks all live in one 8×8 window (chan 5, rows 3-10,
cols 3-10), so one block Slice + Cast + 10 single-axis sub-slices replaces the
10 full [chan,H,W] slices; constants shared → params 152→104. Byte-equal to the
live 2514 (2266/2266, 0 div), memory-neutral, **2466 (−48)**.

Floor verdict for the ENUMERATION formulation (worker2, forced-component
argument — the ~900 floor_est in the prompt is NOT reachable for this rendering
structure; empirically confirmed by this lane's independent Gather formulation
also landing ~2500):
- **Decode 900B is a proven floor**: `feat2`[1,2,15,15]=450 + `color4d`=225 +
  `u_sq`=225. The free UINT8 [1,10,30,30] output forces a trailing QLinearConv
  (any Conv→F32 materializes a 36 KB intermediate; Concat/Where/Pad decodes need
  a [1,10,·] intermediate ≥2250B). QLinearConv needs a 2-channel feature; for 3
  collinear colors + a sentinel-safe pad, `[c, c²]` with codes {1,2,3} is the
  UNIQUE minimal 2-channel encoding — every `[is_red,is_gray]` binary variant
  collides background=(0,0) with padding=(0,0) and breaks trailing-trim.
- **Code plane ~500B floor**: Conv F32 `red_core_code_f`[1,1,10,10]=400 + Cast
  U8 100. Cheapest one-hot→scalar reduction; the full 10×10 is used by the
  assembly (R00/R09/Rmid/R9 span core rows 0-9). ArgMax(INT64) or 15×15 F32
  slices are larger. Any 2nd conv channel to also carry gray costs +400B F32 —
  exceeds the 240B it would save on gray slices, so the separate F32 gray reads
  win.
- **Gray extraction is NOT a separate forced cost (2nd-pass CORRECTION).** My
  first pass claimed the F32 gray window (~256B) was forced because "input is
  F32". FALSE: gray detection folds into the EXISTING code-plane Conv
  (`w_code[5]=3`), so gray rides the 400B F32 read already paid for red. One
  shared `Equal(Rmid,3)` then serves both the interior wipe and the reflected
  masks (w4). This removed ~96B memory + ~55 params the first pass thought were
  forced → **2363**.
- **Routing + assembly + interior-wipe ≈ 860B**: orientation is data-dependent
  (h/v, bar 3/4), so the enumeration (or an equivalent Gather — this lane's
  Gather is empirically worse at 2567) is required; the ~28 8-byte routing
  masks, the 15×15 assembly rows, and the Rmid/is_gray_rmid/Rmid_clean interior
  trio are each near-minimal.
- Sum ≈ 900 (decode) + 500 (conv/code) + 860 (reflect/assembly) + params ≈ 2360
  ≈ the staged **2363**. Decode (900) and the F32 code read (400) are the hard
  forced floor (1300); everything else is the two-orientation reflection, now
  compressed. **WALL for a large (sub-~2200) win without a fundamentally new
  scoreable surface that fuses code-read + reflection + one-hot decode into
  fewer than the ~3 charged 15×15 planes the QLinearConv decode needs. Do not
  re-chase ~900** (the prompt's floor_est ignores the forced free-one-hot
  rendering cost).
